༄༅/khro rgyal rta mgrin nag po'i las byang dregs pa tshar gcod ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅/ khro rgyal rta mgrin nag po'i las byang dregs pa tshar gcod ces bya ba bzhugs so//

na mo gu ru ha ya grī ba ya/ rgyal kun gsung gi dbang phyug lha mchog dpal// gdug pa 'dul phyir gtum drag 'bar ba'i skur// yongs bzhengs khro bo'i rgyal por gus btud nas// de nyid sgrub pa'i las byang 'dir gsal bya//

de la sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes kyi bya ba dang gsum las/ dang po la yo byad kyi gshom dang cho ga'i sngon 'gro gnyis las/ dang po ni gnas khang mdzes par brgyan/ 'di nyid kyi bris sku bkram pa'i mdun du dpal gtor zur gsum pa sha khrag gis brgyan pa dang*/ sman phud/ rakta/ nyer spyod lnga sogs mchod pa dang tshogs rdzas/ rol mo sogs nye bar mkho ba'i yo byad thams cad tshang bar bshams la/ gnyis pa sngon 'gro la bdun las/ dang po skyabs su 'gro ba ni/

rang nyid skad cig gis rta mgrin nag por gsal ba'i thugs kar hūm̐ yig nag po de las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad khro rgyal rta mchog rol pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam par mdun gyi nam mkhar badzra sa mā dzaḥ
zhes spyan drangs la/
hūm̐/ brgyud pa'i rtsa ba bla ma rje// dngos grub 'byung gnas yi dam lha// legs par byin rlob mkha' 'gro ma// rtsa ba gsum la skyabs su mchi//
zhes lan gsum/ gnyis pa sems bskyed pa ni/
hūm̐/ bdag gzhan gnyis med don bsgrub phyir// rta mchog khro rgyal kun bsgrubs nas// snying po bla med byang chub bar// gzhan don byed par sems bskyed do//
zhes lan gsum/ gsum pa yan lag bdun pa ni/

bde gshegs dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la// phyag 'tshal mchod cing sdig pa bshags// dge la yi rang chos 'khor bskor// mya ngan mi 'dar gsol ba 'debs// bla med mchog gi dam tshig rnams// bdag gis deng nas bzung bar bgyi// sems can bde dang ldan gyur cig /sdug bsngal kun dang bral bar shog /bde dang rtag tu mi 'bral zhing*// chos kun mnyam nyid rtogs par shog /dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim par gyur/
bzhi pa bgegs bskrad pa ni/ bgegs gtor bsham/
raṃ yaṃ khaṃ
gis bgegs gtor sbyang*/
stong pa'i ngang las bhrūm̐ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/
lan gsum gyis byin brlab/
sarba bighnān i dam ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi/
zhes lan gsum gyis bsngos la/

hūm̐/ nyon cig bgegs dang log 'dren tshogs// nga yi bka' las ma 'da' bar// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di longs la// 'di ru ma 'dug gzhan du dengs// ci ste mi 'gro 'dug gyur na/ khro rgyal rta mgrin thugs khros nas// mtshon cha ral gri lcags kyu yis/ khyod kyi lus ngag yid gsum rnams// rdul phran bzhin du brlag par byed// de bas rang rang gnas su dengs// oṃ badzra kro dha ha ya grī ba hūm̐ phaṭaḥ
ces drag sngags rol mo'i tsham rngam dang bcas pas bgegs bskrad/ lnga pa mtshams bcad pa ni/

hūm̐/ nga yi dkyil 'khor brtan bya'i phyir/ khro rgyal byin rlabs las byung ba'i// mtshon cha rnam pa sna tshogs kyis// dkyil 'khor rim pa tshul bzhin bsrung*// hūm̐/ steng yang rdo rje'i gur khang la// rdo rje'i thog dang ser chen 'beb// 'og kyang rdo rje'i sa gzhi la// rdo rje'i tshwa tshwa skar ltar 'khrugs// phyogs mtshams rdo rjes gtams pa yi// rdo rje'i mtshams las ma 'da' zhig /oṃ badzra rakṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ steng yang 'khor lo'i gur khang la// 'khor lo'i thog dang ser chen 'beb// 'og kyang 'khor lo'i sa gzhi la// 'khor lo'i tshwa tshwa skar ltar 'khrugs// phyogs mtshams 'khor los gtams pa yi// 'khor lo'i mtshams las ma 'da' zhig /oṃ tsakra rakṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ steng yang rgya gram gur khang la// rgya gram thog dang ser chen 'beb// 'og kyang rgya gram sa gzhi la// rgya gram tshwa tshwa skar ltar 'khrugs// phyogs mtshams rgya gram gtams pa yi// rgya gram mtshams las ma 'da' zhig /oṃ nā nā badzra rakṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ steng yang be con gur khang la// be con thog dang ser chen 'beb// 'og kyang be con sa gzhi la// be con tshwa tshwa skar ltar 'khrugs// phyogs mtshams be con gtams pa yi// be con mtshams las ma 'da' zhig /oṃ daṇḍa rakṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ steng yang ral gri'i gur khang la// ral gri'i thog dang ser chen 'beb// 'og kyang ral gri'i sa gzhi la// ral gri'i tshwa tshwa skar ltar 'khrugs// phyogs mtshams ral gris gtams pa yi// ral gri'i mtshams las ma 'da' zhig

/oṃ khaḍga rakṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ steng yang dbyug to'i gur khang la// dbyug to'i thog dang ser chen 'beb// 'og kyang dbyug to'i sa gzhi la// dbyug to'i tshwa tshwa skar ltar 'khrugs// phyogs mtshams dbyug tos gtams pa yi// dbyug to'i mtshams las ma 'da' zhig /oṃ muṅga ra rakṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/
ces pas/

bdag gi ba spu'i khung bu dang shangs kyi rlung sgrom nas khro bo 'chol pa'i tshogs dang*/ mtshon cha sna tshogs dang me dpung 'bar ba'i sprin phung bsam gyis mi khyab par spros/ g.yas su bskor bas gnod byed thams cad tshar bcad nas/ rim pa bzhin du mtshon cha'i gur khang me dpung 'bar bas kun tu khyab par
bsam mo// drug pa byin dbab pa ni/
phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bdag gnas yo byad thams cad la thim par
bsam zhing spos dang rol mor bcas pas/

hūm̐/ chos sku zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang*// gzugs sku 'jigs byed khro bo'i skur ston pa// rta mchog drag po'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams// glog ltar myur ba'i thugs rjes brtser dgongs la// 'dir gshegs dbang skur byin phob dngos grub stsol// ngo mtshar rtags dang mtshan ma myur du ston//
rtsa sngags mthar/
dzñā na ā be sha ya a āḥ
zhes byin dbab/ bdun pa mchod rdzas byin gyis brlab pa ni/

bdag gi thugs ka nas raṃ yaṃ khaṃ 'phros pas ye shes kyi me rlung chur gyur pas/ mchod rdzas kyi nyes skyon dngos 'dzin dri ma thams cad bsregs gtor sbyangs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las bhrūm̐ las bhandha 'bar ba'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams su oṃ las phyi nang gsang ba'i 'dod pa'i yon tan so so'i mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas nam mkha' rab 'byams gang ba rnams su gyur
par bsam la/
oṃ badzra arghaṃ āḥhūm̐/
de bzhin du/
pā dyaṃ puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai bidyā shabda āḥhūm̐/
sman phud/

raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las a las thod pa'i snod du sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga la hūm̐ oṃ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥ mūṃ lāṃ māṃ pāṃ tāṃ rnams kyis mtshan pa zhu ba las byung ba'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ
rakta/

raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las a las thod pa'i snod du ra las dgra bgegs bsgral pa'i rakta'i rgya mtsho rba klong 'khrugs pa la/ khams gsum gyi rakta thams cad bsdus shing thim par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā rakta dzwa la maṇḍa la hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ
gtor ma/

raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las gtor gzhong a las ka pā la'i snod du gtor rdzas oṃ las 'dod yon lnga'i phung po zad mi shes pa'i gter du gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā ba liṃ ta te dzo ba liṃ ta ba la ba te gu hya sa ma ya hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ
zhes byin gyis brlab bo// de dag ni sngon 'gro'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la bdun las/ dang po dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor bskyed pa ni/

hūm̐/ skye med spros bral chos kyi dbyings kyi ngang*// 'gag med snying rjes 'gro ba kun la khyab// rang rig ye shes hūm̐ yig mthing gar snang*// de las 'od 'phros rdo rje'i ra ba gur// sra brtan gzhom med ye shes me dpung 'bar// de dbus gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i dbyings// rgyal bsen gza' klu dgra bgegs bsnol ba'i khrir// sna tshogs padma nyi zla'i gdan du bsam// oṃ badzra kro dha ha ya grī ba hūm̐ phaṭa/ bdag nyid khro bo'i rgyal po rta mchog dpal// sku mdog mthing nag rngam zhing khros pa'i gzugs// zhal gdangs mche gtsigs ljags 'dril spyan gsum bgrad// sma ra smin ma dmar ser me ltar 'bar// lcags kyi ral pa sa gzhi khyab par grol// spyi bor rta mgo ljang zhur rta skad 'tsher/ khams gsum dbang sdud srid gsum zil gyis gnon// phyag g.yas gnam lcags 'bar ba'i ral gri phyar// dgra dang bgegs kyi mgo lus dum bur gtubs// g.yon pas 'dzin byed lcags kyus srog snying 'dren// dar nag ber dang dur khrod chas kyis brgyan// gar gyi nyams dgus rnam par rol pa'i sku /zhabs gnyis g.yon brkyang 'dor thabs drag por bgrad// ba spu'i gseb nas me stag tshwa tshwa 'phro// bskal pa'i me dpung 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs// lcags ral bsigs pa'i gseb nas khro chung gi /sprul pa 'phro bas log 'dren tshar bcad nas// tshur 'dus rdo rje khro bo'i gur du 'khrigs// srung dang zlog bsad phrin las rab 'byams mdzad// spyi mgrin snying gar oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan// rdo rje gsum gyi ngo bor byin gyis brlabs// thugs kar nyi steng mthing nag 'bar ba'i hūm̐// gsang sngags phreng bas g.yas su bskor ba las// 'od 'phros rang bzhin gnas nas ye shes pa// sprin phung gtibs pa bzhin du byon par gyur//
zhes gsal gdab bo// gnyis pa spyan 'dren pa ni/
hūm̐/ chos nyid zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang*// thugs rje khros pas dgra bgegs 'joms mdzad pa/ khro mchog dbang gi rgyal po spyan 'dren na// dbang gi rta skad 'tsher zhing gshegs su gsol//
rtsa ba'i sngags mthar/
badzra sa mā dzaḥ
zhes pas spyan drang*/ gsum pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni/

hūm̐/ bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na// dgra bgegs dregs pa bsnol ba'i gdan steng du// dbang gi rgyal po bcom ldan lha yi lha// mi g.yo dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs su gsol// sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan/
zhes pas
dam tshig pa dang dbyer med du gyur
par bsam mo// bzhi pa phyag 'tshal ba ni/

hūm̐/ chags med skyon bral padma rigs kyi lha// klu dbang tshul gyis gdug pa 'dul mdzad pa// rab 'jigs bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar/ khro rgyal rta mgrin sku la phyag 'tshal lo// na mo pu ru sha ya hoḥ a ti pū hoḥ pra ti dza hoḥ
zhes pas phyag bya/ lnga pa mchod pa 'bul ba ni/

hūm̐/ chos nyid mnyam pa chen po'i ngang nyid las// 'dod pa'i yon tan ma 'gags rol par shar// me tog bdug spos snang gsal dri chab dang*// zhal zas rol mo'i bye brag sna tshogs dang*// gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos la sogs// ma 'gags thabs kyi mchod pa bzhes su gsol// oṃ badzra kro dha ha ya grī ba sa pa ri bā ra badzra puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai bidyā shabda rū pa shabda gandhe ra sa sparshe dharma dhā tu pū dza hoḥ
zhes pa phyi mchod dang*/

hūm̐/ dug gsum dgra bgegs bsgral pa'i sha khrag dang*// dug lnga sman sbyar bdud rtsi chen po 'di/ khro mchog dbang gi sku la mchod par 'bul// srid gsum gdug pa 'dul phyir bzhes su gsol// ma hā pū dza hoḥ
zhes nang mchod dang khyad par du/
khro bo'i rgyal po'i ljags rdo rje'i sbu gu can gyis gtor ma'i bcud drangs nas gsol bar
bsam la/ rtsa sngags kyi mthar/
yaksha nag po dgra bgegs mā ra ya/ māṃ sa rakta tsitta go ro tsa na ba su ta kiṃ ni ri ti ba liṃ ta kha raṃ khā hi/

zhes lan gsum mam bdun gyis phul zhing*/ gzhung gi dngos bstan de tsam gyis tshang ba'i phyir chog mod/ spro na sman raka gtor ma'i gyer tshig rigs mthun gzhan nas blangs kyang rung ngo*// drug pa bstod pa ni/

hūm̐/ chos sku skye med ngang las ma g.yos kyang*// longs sku 'jigs pa'i cha lugs rdzogs mdzad cing*// 'bar ba'i rgyal po dbang gi skur sprul nas// 'jig rten dregs pa 'dul la phyag 'tshal bstod// sku mdog mthing nag chos nyid 'gyur ba med// dar nag ber chen snang srid zil gyis gnon// spyi gtsug rta mgo sna tshogs phrin las rdzogs// bdud 'dul nag po che la phyag 'tshal bstod// phyag g.yas ral gris dgra bgegs rtsad nas gcod// g.yon pas lcags kyus ma rungs snying nas 'dren// lcags ral gseb nas khro chung sprul pa 'gyed// gnod sbyin gdug pa 'duul la phyag 'tshal bstod// zhal gdangs ljags 'dril mche ba rab tu gtsigs// spyan gsum sdang mig smin ma glaug stong 'gyu// dpal gyi chas ldan me phung klong na 'gying*// rab 'jigs dpa' bo che la phyag 'tshal bstod// hūm̐ gi nga ros khams gsum dbang du sdud// phaṭa kyi 'brug sgras log lta ma rungs 'joms// rta skad drag pos dregs pa las la bskul// gsung mchog rig sngags rgyal la phyag 'tshal bstod// thugs nyid spros dang bral ba'i rang bzhin las// ye shes lnga yi mtshan ma cir yang ston// thugs rje thabs mkhas rgya che rol pa yi// yon tan phrin las rdzogs la phyag 'tshal bstod//
ces bstod nas/

hūm̐/ thugs rje chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs// thugs rje'i dbang gis khro rgyal skur ston pa// gar gyi dbang phyug khro bo kun gyi rje// ye shes sprul pa'i khro tshogs 'khor dang bcas// bka' yi pho nya dregs pa sde brgyad tshogs// sngon gyi khas blangs dam bcas ji bzhin du// thugs dam dbang gis gtor ma 'di bzhes la// dam tshig dbang gis rnal 'byor bdag cag skyongs// byang chub lam gyi bar chad bsgral ba dang*// bstan pa bshig pa'i dgra bgegs la sogs pa// bdud dang log par 'dren pa thams cad la// mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las sgrub par mdzod//
ces phrin las bcol/ bdun pa dzap bzla ba ni/

hūm̐/ bdag gi thugs ka'i sa bon sngags phreng las// 'od zer phyir 'phros stong gsum 'jig rten gang*// rgyal ba mchod cing byin rlabs dngos grub bsdus// dregs pa tshar bcad mthu dang nus pa 'phrog /dwangs ma tshur 'dus snang grags lha dang sngags// dag pa rab 'byams chos dbyings chen por rdzogs//
zhes pa'i don gsal btab nas/
oṃ badzra kro dha ha ya grī ba hūm̐ phaṭa:
ces bsnyen sngags so//

yaksha nag po nṛ tri hur thuṃ dza: gnod byed mā ra ya: srog la rbad rbad: snying la rbad rbad: rtsa la rbad rbad: khrag la rbad rbad: sha la rbad rbad: rus pa la rbad rbad: klad pa la rbad rbad: yid la rbad rbad: tsitta zung zung: tsitta rmugs rmugs: tsitta phyungs phyungs: tsitta gtubs gtubs: tsitta myog myog: tsitta thuṃ ril: ya ya bhyo bhyo: srog rtsa chod chod: snying rtsa phyungs phyungs: khaṃ khaṃ laṃ laṃ: tshal par rbad rbad: dum bur rbud rbud: thuṃ myog baṃ ril: mā ra ya rbad sod: raṃ raṃ dzwa la raṃ: u tsa ta ya phaṭa:

ces spu gri las kyi sngags so// de ltar yang*/ bsnyen pa'i dus su rtsa sngags bzla// sgrub pa'i dus su las sngags rkyang par bzla// las sbyor las sngags rkyang par bzla// bsnyen sngags bung ba tshang tshol 'dra// sgrub sngags me dpung 'bar ba 'dra// las sngags ser chen 'beb pa 'dra// sngags kyi gnad la gsum yin te// 'gal me 'khor ba lta bu dang*// ba thag khrid pa lta bu dang*// me sgyogs 'phangs pa lta bu 'o// zhes pa'i gces gnad rnams nges par byas la tshul bzhin du bzla'o// gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa la bdun las/ dang po tshogs mchod la bshams shing byin gyis brlab pa ni/ tshogs kyi yo byad rnams bshams la bdud rtsi'i bsang gtor byas nas/

thugs las raṃ yaṃ khaṃ 'phros pas// ma dag nyes skyon bsregs gtor bkrus// bhrūm̐ las rin chen snod nang du// tshogs rdzas sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga// rigs lnga'i dam tshig 'dod yon rdzas// zag med nam mkha' gang bar gyur// oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ
zhes byin brlabs/ tshogs zhing spyan 'dren pa ni/
hūm̐/ e yig stong nyid zhing khams nas// waṃ yig bde chen rdo rje'i sku /dbang chen khro rgyal rta mchog dpal/ khro tshogs sprul par bcas pa rnams// spyan 'dren gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol//
rtsa sngags mthar/
badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ
zhes spyan drangs nas
1$0000250me tog la sogs pas mchod/ 1$0000300
de nas tshogs phud cha gsum du byas la/ dang po mchod pa ni/
gzugs sgra dri ro reg ldan pa'i// 'dod yon tshogs kyi mchod pa 'di// gus pa'i blo yis 'bul lags na// dgyes pa'i gar gyis bzhes su gsol// ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi/
bar pa bshags pa ni/
thog med dus nas da lta'i bar// sgo gsum mi shes bag med pas// nyams chag 'gal 'khrul ci mchis pa// de dag thams cad bshags par bgyi//
zhes dang*/ yig brgya bzla'o// tha ma bsgral ba ni/ tshogs zan nam dmigs bya'i rū pa bcas la bden stobs brjod nas dmigs bya 'gugs bstim bya/

hūm̐/ khro bo'i rgyal po rta mchog dpal// 'khor dang bcas pa'i dus la babs// gdug can dgra dang bgegs kyi tshogs/ khug cig ā karṣa ya dzaḥ phur bu 'bar bas srog rtsa chod// sna tshogs mtshon chas dum bur gtubs// rdo rje tho bas rdul du bcom// rnam shes skye med dbyings su drongs// nṛ tri sha trūn mā ra ya rbad/
snyigs ma'i sha khrag bdud rtsir spel la stob pa ni/
dgra bgegs bsgral pa'i sha khrag rus// don snying nang rol bcas pa rnams// ye shes bdud rtsir byin brlabs nas// bzhes shig rol cig dgyes par mdzod// māṃ sa rakta kiṃ ni ri ti khā hi/
zhes 'bul/ de nas tshogs rdzas rnams brda dang brda'i 'bul len gyis dam tshig bsre ba sngon du 'gro bas tshogs la rol/ lhag ma rnams bsdus la kha phrus bdud rtsir spel te/
hūm̐/ sngon gyi zhal bzhes dam mnos bzhin// dkyil 'khor chen po'i phyi nyul ba'i// lhag gtor dbang ba'i srung ma rnams// 'di bzhes bcol pa'i phrin las mdzod// oṃ utstshiṣṭa ba liṃ ta khā hi/
zhes phyi rol du dor/ gnyis pa thugs dam bskul ba ni/

hūm̐/ gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor du// dgra bgegs dregs pa bsnol ba'i gdan steng nas// rta mgrin nag po sku bzhengs shig /yaksha nag po sku bzhengs shig /gnod sbyin nag po sku bzhengs shig /las mkhan nag po sku bzhengs shig /bzhengs shig chos kyi dbyings nas bzhengs// bskul lo yaksha mthu bo che// rbad do dam nyams dgra la rbad// ma g.yel srung ma thugs dam can// dam rdzas gtor ma 'di bzhes la// sangs rgyas bstan pa khyed kyis srungs// dkon mchog dbu 'phang khyed kyis bstod// rnal 'byor sku tshe khyed kyis srings// yon bdag bar chad khyed kyis sol// sdang ba'i dgra la rtags phyungs shig /gnod pa'i bgegs la las mdzod cig /khyed kyi phrin las dus la babs// dus la bab bo sa ma ya// bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod//
ces bskul lo// gsum pa chad tho bsgrag pa ni/ chos skyong gtor ma sogs gtor gral nas blangs pa stegs la bkod/ sman raka bran nas 'bru gsum gyis bdud rtsir spel la/

hūm̐/ sngon gyi bskal pa'i dang po la// slob dpon padma 'byung gnas kyis// bka' dang dam la btags pa yi// chos skyong srung ma dam tshig can// 'khor bcas 'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// sngon gyi khas blangs dam bcas bzhin// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi// nad gdon mi mthun zhi ba dang*// tshe dbang longs spyod rgyas par spel// 'jig rten dregs pa dbang du sdus// dgra bgegs gdug pa'i dpung tshogs choms// bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod//

ces gtor ma phyir 'bul/ bzhi pa zor 'phang ba ni/ dmigs bsal gyi las bsgrub dgos na rtsa ba'i gzhung nyid lag len du thebs pa'i man ngag la 'dris par bya zhing*/ rgyun gyi phrin las chad tho'i gtor ma nyid zor du 'phang bas kyang 'grub pa'i phyir de tsam mo// lnga pa brtan ma skyong ba ni/ gtor gzhong bshal ba'i phud kyis gtor mar bran nas bdud rtsir spel la/
bhyoḥ slob dpon padma thod phreng gi /bka' nyan ma mo brtan ma'i tshogs// dam rdzas dpal gyi gtor ma longs// bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod//
ces gtor ma phyir 'bul lo// drug pa bro brdung ba ni/ gtor gzhong sbubs pa ri rab tu gsal ba'i 'og tu dam sri mnan par bsam la/

hūm̐/ nga ni 'jigs byed chen po ste// dgra bgegs 'byung po spyi nas gnon// dgra bgegs sdig can 'byung po rnams// dug gsum las kyi khung bur mnan// mnan no bcings so st+wambha ya// rdo rje'i bro yis rgyas gdab pas// sus kyang 'jig par nus ma yin// oṃ laṃ āḥlaṃ hūm̐ laṃ st+wambha ya nan/
zhes khro bo'i stangs stabs kyi bro bya'o// bdun pa mtha' rgyas ni/ slar mchod cing bstod nas/ yig brgya mang du bzla/
ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*//
zhes sogs kyis bzod par gsol/
hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/
zhes brjod pas/

rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ snod bcud thams cad 'od du zhu nas rang la thim/ rang yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ la thim/ hūm̐ gyen rdzogs mi dmigs spros pa dang bral ba'i ngang la bzhag /phaṭa phaṭa phaṭaḥ
ces brjod pas/

slar yang dpal chen po rta mgrin gyi skur langs pa'i gnas gsum oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur/ dge 'dis mtha' yas sems can kun/ khro rgyal dpa' bo rta mgrin gyi// go 'phang byang chub myur thob nas// bdud las rnam par rgyal bar shog /oṃ/ byin rlabs mchog stsol rigs brgya'i bdag /bla ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog /dngos grub char 'beb zhi dang khro// yi dam lha tshogs bkra shis shog /thogs med phrin las sgrub mdzad pa// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i bkra shis shog /gang la bsam pa'i don kun 'grub// dge legs mchog gi bkra shis shog /

ces shis pa brjod pas bde legs kyis khyab par bya'o// mthu stobs thogs med rno myur lha// padma'i zhal lung bzang po'i lam// nyang gter dbang chen rta mchog gi /sgrub thabs phrin las 'jug bde'i dpal// snying po'i gnad kyi gzhung dril zhing*/ kha skong khrigs kyis gsal mdzes pa// 'di las bsod nams gang thob de// 'gro kun sangs rgyas 'thob phyir bsngo/ khro rgyal rta mgrin nag po lcags ral can nyang gter gyi las byang dregs pa tshar gcod ces bya ba 'di ni/ lhag pa'i lha 'di nyid la mchog tu gus pa dang ldan pa skyi shod nyang bran sngags 'chang rta mgrin mchog grub kyis nan tan chen pos bskul ba la/ gter gzhung rtsa ba'i yi ger gzhir byas/ kha skong bar 'os pa rnams cho ga rigs mthun nas blangs te/ snga 'gyur las byang spyi'i 'gros dang mthun par rig pa 'dzin pa 'gyur med rdo rjes o rgyan smin grol gling gi chos grwar bkod pa'i yi ge pa ni 'gyur med bstan rgyas so// sarba maṅga laṃ// //
